title: Keyframes on a cube
summary: Keyframes are the poses; Blender makes the in-betweens. On frame 1 the cube gets a key for location and rotation (I); with auto keying on, frame 30 only the changed rotation is keyed, so the cube already starts moving from frame 1; frame 60 it is moved and turned again. The fix: a location key on frame 30 so it stays put until then.

objects.name: Cube
objects.description: the default cube, keyed at frames 1, 30 and 60

expected_result: A 60-frame animation: the cube turns in place, then moves and turns to a new spot.

steps.note: select the cube, I: a key for location and rotation on frame 1
auto keying on: frame 30, R Z 45 -- only the rotation gets a key
it drifts from frame 1 because nothing tells it to stay: a location key on frame 30 fixes it
the camera (Numpad 0) sees the whole move
